(AP Photo/Nick Wass)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Joey Aliberti | JAliberti@syracuse.comThe Toronto Blue Jays host the Los Angeles Dodgers in the second of a three-game series Tuesday at 7:07 p.m. ET. The Dodgers beat Toronto 14-2 Monday, which was their first matchup since the 2025 World Series. Dodgers vs. Blue Jays will air on TBS, and streams live on DIRECTV (free trial).What: MLB regular seasonWho: Los Angeles Dodgers (8-2) vs. Toronto Blue Jays (4-6)When: Tuesday, April 7, 2026Where: Rogers Centre, Toronto, CanadaTime: 7:07 p.m. ET TV: TBS, MLB.TV, Sportsnet Live stream: DIRECTV (free trial)Get DIRECTV free trialGet a five-day free trial and up to $35 off your first month of DIRECTV.Buy NowWhat to know about Dodgers vs. Blue JaysHere’s a recent baseball story from the Associated Press:TORONTO (AP) — Dalton Rushing hit two solo home runs for his first career multihomer game and the Los Angeles Dodgers went deep five times to rout the Toronto Blue Jays 14-2 on Monday night in a rematch of the 2025 World Series.Teoscar Hernández and Freddie Freeman each hit a two-run homer, and Shohei Ohtani added a solo shot.Los Angeles beat the Blue Jays in last year’s Fall Classic for its second consecutive championship, winning Game 7 at Toronto in 11 innings.After scoring 31 runs in a three-game sweep at Washington, the Dodgers piled up 17 hits against the slumping Blue Jays. Rushing went 4 for 4 and also scored after he was hit by a pitch.Rushing connected on Tommy Nance’s first pitch of the seventh, then went deep again off Spencer Miles in the eighth.Hernández went 2 for 5 with a walk and drove in four runs, while Freeman was 2 for 4 with a walk and three RBIs. Kyle Tucker had a hit, walked and scored three times, and drove in a run with a sacrifice fly. Andy Pages had two hits, including a two-run double.Blue Jays catcher Tyler Heineman came on to pitch the ninth and retired the side in order, Toronto’s only 1-2-3 inning of the game.The Blue Jays lost their fifth straight and saw right-hander and three-time Cy Young Award winner Max Scherzer (1-1) leave after two innings. The 41-year-old allowed two runs and two hits, walked one and struck out a pair.Hernández homered off Scherzer in the first. Freeman drilled a 438-foot shot off Josh Fleming in the third.Ohtani homered off Joe Mantiply in the sixth, his third in four games.Making his first start of the season, Dodgers left-hander Justin Wrobleski (1-0) allowed one run and two hits in five innings.Up nextWorld Series MVP Yoshinobu Yamamoto (1-1, 3.00 ERA) is scheduled to start Tuesday against Blue Jays RHP Kevin Gausman (0-0, 0.75).Where to watch Mets vs. Dodgers today: MLB free live streamWhere to watch Warriors vs. Clippers today: NBA Play-In free live streamWhere to watch LA Galaxy vs. Toluca today: Concacaf soccer free live streamWhere to watch Stars vs. Sabres today: NHL free live streamWhere to watch Naples vs. Orlando City SC: US Open Cup free streamJoey Aliberti is a Sports Commerce Reporter for syracuse.com | The Post-Standard, covering sports, TV, streaming and tickets for teams including the Buffalo Bills, New York Jets, New York Giants, New York...
